title: Shapes, Colors, Arts
description: Shapes, colors, mixing, patterns, and creative play.

levels.title: Circle
levels.lessonText: A circle is round with no corners. Find circles around you.

levels.title: Square
levels.lessonText: A square has four equal sides and four corners.

levels.title: Triangle
levels.lessonText: A triangle has three sides and three corners.

levels.title: Rectangle
levels.lessonText: A rectangle has four sides with two long and two short.

levels.title: Oval
levels.lessonText: An oval looks like a stretched circle, like an egg.

levels.title: Shapes Review
levels.lessonText: Review circle, square, triangle, rectangle, and oval.

levels.title: Colors: Red and Blue
levels.lessonText: Red like a tomato. Blue like the sky. Say the colors.
levels.prompt: Which color is like the sunny sky?

levels.title: Colors: Yellow and Green
levels.lessonText: Yellow like a banana. Green like a leaf.
levels.prompt: Which color is like a leaf?

levels.title: Colors: Orange and Purple
levels.lessonText: Orange like an orange fruit. Purple like an eggplant.
levels.prompt: Which color is like an orange fruit?

levels.title: Colors Review
levels.lessonText: Review red, blue, yellow, green, orange, and purple.
levels.prompt: Which color is like a ripe tomato?

levels.title: Color Mixing: Red + Yellow
levels.lessonText: Mix red and yellow to make orange. Try it with paint.
levels.prompt: Red plus yellow makes which color?

levels.title: Color Mixing: Blue + Yellow
levels.lessonText: Mix blue and yellow to make green. Try it with paint.
levels.prompt: Blue plus yellow makes which color?

levels.title: Banig Patterns
levels.lessonText: Patterns repeat. Look at the weave and find what comes next.
levels.prompt: Red, blue, red, blue, _. What comes next?

levels.title: Art Review
levels.lessonText: Review shapes, colors, mixing, and patterns together.
levels.prompt: Which shape is round with no corners?

levels.title: Free Painting Finale
levels.lessonText: Create your own picture using shapes and colors you learned.
levels.prompt: Which color do you want to paint the sun?
